meta.name: autonomous-investigation
meta.description: The protocol behind every investigation skill. Use when AI research must proceed without you: search-plan gate, Fact/Inference/Assumption labels, confidence stacking, diffable outputs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI研究自动进行，无需人工介入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要AI自主完成多步骤调研并输出结构化结果
copy.tagline_en: Let AI research proceed without manual intervention
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to autonomously conduct multi-step research and output structured results

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 做自主调查时会遵守一套协议：先展示 3 条搜索计划；把每条关键说法标成“事实/推断/假设”；查不到的列入“缺口”清单；不编造来源；输出结构固定，方便和上次运行对比。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 去搜资料、做调研，而你不会逐条回答它的追问；或者要它按固定时间自动重跑同一调查时触发。

say.text: 调查一下 X 公司最近的裁员情况，用于我们调整明年的预算。
say.note: 它会显示搜索计划，给证据贴标签，最后给你 4 个下一步选项。

say.text: 用 autonomous-investigation 调研 Y 行业。
say.note: 它会自动搜索并输出带事实/推断/假设标注的报告。

say.text: 每季度末自动跑一次这个调查，并对比上次结果。
say.note: 它会按固定格式输出，差异部分就是需要关注的变更。

howto.what_en: When Claude does autonomous research, it follows a protocol: shows a 3-bullet search plan, labels claims as Fact/Inference/Assumption, lists gaps, never invents sources, and outputs in a stable format for easy diffing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to research on its own without you answering questions, or for scheduled re-runs.

say_en.text: Investigate X Corp's recent layoffs to inform our next budget.
say_en.note: It shows a search plan, labels evidence, and lists next steps.

say_en.text: Use autonomous-investigation to scan the competitive landscape in Y sector.
say_en.note: It auto-searches and outputs a labeled report.

say_en.text: Re-run this investigation quarterly and compare with last time.
say_en.note: Stable format makes the delta visible.
